Make this a Castle Age siege workshop: a large solid workshop with a tall wide arched timber gate on the front through which a battering ram is half visible, a half-built trebuchet arm and stacked beams in a small walled yard at one corner. It sits flat and square on its plot, with no dark rim or shadow under it. Clearly a strong later-age building, not a wooden yard. Make this an Infirmary, a medieval house of healing: a calm two-storey hall with a covered porch where a few straw cots with white linen are visible, a small walled herb garden at one front corner with green herbs in rows, bundles of drying herbs hanging under the eaves, a water barrel, a small white banner with a red cross over the door. Clearly not a church: no tower, no spire, no bell. It sits flat and square on its plot.
